name: Akagi Chisato
source:
Chisato is [url=/c1501]Kouhei’s[/url] new younger sister who he meets in the street one day when he saves her from a dog. She’s very shy and quiet and is also afraid of men. Chisato has just started attending the school that everyone else goes to. She enjoys gardening and is also quite a good cook.

[From [url=http://liemyx.wordpress.com/2011/08/12/relations-sister-x-sister-review/]Liemyx's review[/url].]
